metadata.title: A Dimension-Free Bound on the Poincaré Constant of Isotropic Log-Concave Measures
metadata.abstract: The Kannan--Lovász--Simonovits (KLS) conjecture asks whether isotropic log-concave probability measures satisfy a Poincaré inequality with a constant independent of dimension. In this paper, we establish a dimension-free Poincaré inequality and hence a universal positive lower bound for the Euclidean Cheeger constant, thereby proving the KLS conjecture. Our proof has three steps. First, we study integration operators that undo differentiation and prove a curvature estimate that is uniform in the number of tensor indices. Second, an operator lemma turns bounds for low-degree polynomials into bounds for any number of integrations, with one common multiplicative factor. Third, we use stochastic localization to transfer the integration bounds back to polynomial norms.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: KLS 猜想的无维 Poincaré 下界
analysis.workSummary: 作者宣称证明 isotropic log-concave 测度的无维 Poincaré 不等式，以统一张量积分曲率估计、算子引理及 stochastic localization 构成三步路线。
analysis.breakthrough: 若正文论证成立，将证明 KLS 猜想及无维 Cheeger 下界。
analysis.limitations: 必须核查从低次多项式到任意积分次数的统一因子及局部化传递，不能将摘要宣称当作独立验证。
analysis.priorityReason: 若正文论证成立，将证明 KLS 猜想及无维 Cheeger 下界。
